description: Shared Renovate settings for pnpm/Node apps released with release-please

packageRules.description: Dependency updates are chores, so they wait for the next feat or fix release instead of each cutting one. config:recommended would title production dependencies fix(deps)
Leave engines.node alone while the new Node.js version still satisfies it. The global bump strategy would raise it to every new patch
Group Node.js and its types across mise.toml, the Dockerfile, and package.json
Keep pnpm on one version in mise.toml, package.json, and the Dockerfile
Group Hono with its middleware and server packages, which declare peer ranges on it
Group the opentelemetry-js and opentelemetry-js-contrib monorepos. Their instrumentations pin the same exact 0.x @opentelemetry/instrumentation
Group Vite with its plugins, which declare peer ranges on it, and Rolldown, which the server build uses directly. A Vite release usually moves its Rolldown range, so the updates land in one PR
Group Oxlint with its ESLint-rules plugin, which releases with it, and tsgolint, whose minimum version Oxlint sets
Add the React types to group:monorepos' React group
Group drizzle-orm with drizzle-kit, which generates its migrations, and drizzle-zod
